top_signals.title: Russia using own version of Starlink for military comms over Ukraine, Kyiv says
top_signals.summary: Russia is already using its new Rassvet satellite network — billed as a homegrown version of Starlink — for military communications over Ukraine, according to Ukrainian military intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
